A couple of parents looking for a preschool for their daughter were presented with two choices, one had a female teacher and the other a male teacher. The parents chose the school with the female teacher because she had more years of work experience than the male teacher, and the male teacher got a lot of negative reviews on Yelp. Who is a bad preschool teacher?
A. The female teacher
B. Can't answer
C. The male teacher
